services.purpose: Private CPU/RAM dashboard for the Linux kernel visible to Docker; no host disk, network, GPU, namespace or sibling-container access.

acceptance.description: Require pinned /config with the exact bounded profile, positive CPU threads/RAM size from /info, all per-core CPU samples in [0,100], and RAM load within its total. This proves visible CPU/RAM API data, not host identity or freshness.

Independently compare kernel CPU count/RAM total and refreshed samples. Linux Docker usually exposes kernel-wide /proc, not the service cgroup quota; Docker VM or virtualized /proc changes scope. Do not infer physical-host identity, disks, network or sibling-container metrics.
Restart only this owned project and repeat the CPU/RAM API contract; no account or API key is created.
